svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Strip the bought frame: wheels, axle and axle brackets off.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the shaft line on both rails, 142.5 mm above the toe plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut off any cross bar between 80 mm below and 360 mm above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft line (on the model frame, the bar 60 mm above it); grind

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rails smooth and paint the bare steel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 22 mm tube to fit between the rails (372 mm inside); cope both

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld it between the rails 105 mm below the shaft line, on the rail

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line, square to both rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The axle plates and skid standoffs then weld to the rails

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: rails still 400 mm apart, within 1 mm, at the new bar.
